title: Slushie Bar Xtra Tropical Twist 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Slushie Bar Xtra Tropical Twist captures the essence of exotic tropical fruits, creating a juicy and refreshingly sweet vape. This vibrant blend brings together a variety of luscious tropical flavours, offering a bright and uplifting experience with every puff. Perfect for vapers who enjoy fruit-inspired e-liquids, Tropical Twist delivers a fresh and flavourful vape that can be enjoyed all day long. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Slushie Bar Xtra Nic Salts are designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) vape kits and pod systems. Each e-liquid in the collection provides smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine relief, making them ideal for those seeking a satisfying alternative to traditional tobacco. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these e-liquids are perfect for all-day vaping with a flavour-packed experience waiting in every puff.
